desc:
🌺 Welcome to Dig A Plant!

How to Play:
🌻 Dig and steal plants from animals
🌱 Grow seeds to collect rare plants
💰 Earn money from your plants
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and base
🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
✨ Discover rarer plants and mutations!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet players
